in_marathi.name: Gunaakar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे One who possesses good virtues and prosperity
in_marathi.long_meaning: Gunaakar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Gunaakar is a Sanskrit and Hindi name that is derived from the words 'guna' meaning virtue, and 'akar' meaning to make or to do. This name signifies someone who possesses good virtues and has the ability to create prosperity in their life. This name is often given to a child as a blessing for a good future.
